description.narrative:
In mid-2020, the Federation of Trade Unions of Macedonia (SSM) launched a new campaign with free legal service to members with workplace conflicts generated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Since the beginning of the crisis, SSM provided aid to workers in several companies, with more than 80,000 workers benefitting from enhanced focus on services. A special webpage was established. Services were provided by phone or e-mail. In exceptional cases, SSM had meetings with representatives of workers and employers following the health protocols. A phone application was introduced (mid-2021) for workers to report directly to SSM's legal department violations of rights, harassment and unsafe working conditions. The application (over 500 downloads) is used to address various issues, including wage arrears. In June 2021, 100 workers not receiving full salaries following their company's bankruptcy used the application to involve the trade union that took the case to court. The application is linked to the labour inspectorate through an agreement with the union. SSM also created an e-adviser service (a digital character called Sindi), responding to more general questions by workers as well as a video to promote new services.
The Confederation of Free Trade Unions of Macedonia (KSS) opened a legal service help line for workers during the pandemic. 73 cases were solved through this service, ten were not completed positively, five were taken to court. In April/May 2021, KSS produced a promotional video on the union's role and objectives and an e-platform for registration of new members.
In mid-2021, the Union of Independent and Autonomous Trade Unions of Macedonia provided new services through an online SOS line where members can report cases of harassment at work to the union. By September 2021, the union had addressed 276 cases of violence and harassment at work. The cases are being addressed by the new Legal Clinic (established mid-2021), where the union provides legal advice to The ILO, with the support of the European Union, supported the development of new and enhanced services and the marketing of these services through their web pages and social media (mainly facebook and youtube).
In the beginning of 2020, ILO issued a call for proposals from workers organizations to enhance existing services and/or introduce new services. Guidance was given to unions to develop the proposals. ILO received 18 proposals for developing new and/or strengthen existing services for members and potential members. After evaluation, ILO supported the implementation the four best proposals for enhancement of trade union services by four unions, including the Confederation of Free Trade Unions of Macedonia (KSS) and the Federation of Trade Unions of Macedonia (SSM).
The four unions received financial support to start up new and enhanced services from mid-2020, and received technical guidance throughout the process.
The trade unions were supported in marketing the new and enhanced services to members and potential members. This was done through the use of external experts in marketing working together with the trade unions.
At the same time (April/June 2021), the Federation of Trade Unions of Macedonia (SSM) was supported in a rebranding and digitalization effort to get closer to existing and potential members, and in particular youth. This activity involved design of posters, promotional videos and branded communication products.
